purpose: Post-hoc numerical sensitivity of the lowest weighted-match SXS case. Hold the long-start physical row, native choices, output grid, and fine RKF45 resampling fixed while changing only ODE tolerances. This is neither a physical holdout nor a release gate.
interpretation: Compare unaligned raw modes on nested output samples and weighted modes after separately applying the pre-existing fixed-frequency anchor. A three-level monotone trend is only numerical stability evidence; near-floor float64 tolerances and the post-hoc row prevent claiming asymptotic order or physical accuracy.
